list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS __text, h.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName IN ('MECM.SiteServer', 'MECM.ManagementPoint', 'MECM.DistributionPoint', 'MECM.SoftwareUpdatePoint', 'MECM.ServiceConnectionPoint', 'MECM.SQLServer', 'MECM.ServerComponent')
  AND h.DisplayName IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

title: SCCM Monitoring - Overview

panels.description: Servers of the selected set that run Configuration Manager roles or components.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ent AS (
  SELECT v.Id, t.Name AS Class, v.HealthState, LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) AS Host
  FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
  WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND NULLIF(v.Path, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND t.Name IN ('MECM.SiteServer', 'MECM.ManagementPoint', 'MECM.DistributionPoint', 'MECM.SoftwareUpdatePoint', 'MECM.ServiceConnectionPoint', 'MECM.SQLServer', 'MECM.SDKProvider', 'MECM.ContentStorageDrive', 'MECM.ServerComponent')
), sel AS (SELECT * FROM ent WHERE Host IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ',')))
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Host) FROM sel) AS "Servers",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sel WHERE Class <> 'MECM.ServerComponent') AS "Roles",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sel WHERE Class <> 'MECM.ServerComponent' AND HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "Roles not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sel WHERE Class = 'MECM.ServerComponent') AS "Components",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sel WHERE Class = 'MECM.ServerComponent' AND HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "Components not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.Id) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView w JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView wt ON wt.Id = w.MonitoringClassId
    WHERE w.IsDeleted = 0 AND wt.Name = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher' AND w.HealthState IN (2, 3) AND w.DisplayName IN (SELECT DISTINCT Host FROM sel)) AS "Agents not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.ResolutionState, al.TimeRaised, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
   WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
     AND ((a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'MECM.%' AND (LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, ''), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, '') + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ',')) OR NULLIF(a.MonitoringObjectPath, '') IS NULL))
          OR (a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' AND a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ','))))) AS "Open Configuration Manager alerts"

panels.title: Open alerts

panels.description: Health is the worst of the roles and components on the server. A server that is powered off turns the agent heartbeat Critical after about five minutes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ent AS (
  SELECT v.Id, t.Name AS Class, v.HealthState, v.StateLastModified, LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) AS Host
  FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
  WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND NULLIF(v.Path, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND t.Name IN ('MECM.SiteServer', 'MECM.ManagementPoint', 'MECM.DistributionPoint', 'MECM.SoftwareUpdatePoint', 'MECM.ServiceConnectionPoint', 'MECM.SQLServer', 'MECM.SDKProvider', 'MECM.ContentStorageDrive', 'MECM.ServerComponent')
), hosts AS (SELECT DISTINCT Host FROM ent WHERE Host IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ',')))
SELECT TOP 200
  h.Host AS Host,
  CASE x.worst WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Health,
  x.roles AS Roles,
  x.roles_bad AS "Roles not healthy",
  x.comps AS Components,
  x.comps_bad AS "Components not healthy",
  CASE hb.hs WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Agent heartbeat",
  x.since AS LastStateChange
FROM hosts h
OUTER APPLY (SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.Class <> 'MECM.ServerComponent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS roles,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.Class <> 'MECM.ServerComponent' AND e.HealthState IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS roles_bad,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.Class = 'MECM.ServerComponent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comps,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.Class = 'MECM.ServerComponent' AND e.HealthState IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comps_bad,
    MAX(e.HealthState) AS worst, MAX(e.StateLastModified) AS since
  FROM ent e WHERE e.Host = h.Host) x
OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(w.HealthState) AS hs FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView w JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView wt ON wt.Id = w.MonitoringClassId
             WHERE w.IsDeleted = 0 AND wt.Name = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher' AND w.DisplayName = h.Host) hb
ORDER BY CASE x.worst WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, h.Host

panels.title: Configuration Manager servers (click a server for detail)

panels.description: The hierarchy, the site and every role with its current health.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1), ''), '(site)') AS Host,
  CASE t.Name WHEN 'MECM.PrimarySite' THEN 'Primary site' WHEN 'MECM.Hierarchy' THEN 'Hierarchy' WHEN 'MECM.SiteServer' THEN 'Site server' WHEN 'MECM.ManagementPoint' THEN 'Management point'
              WHEN 'MECM.DistributionPoint' THEN 'Distribution point' WHEN 'MECM.SoftwareUpdatePoint' THEN 'Software update point' WHEN 'MECM.ServiceConnectionPoint' THEN 'Service connection point'
              WHEN 'MECM.SQLServer' THEN 'Site database (SQL Server)' WHEN 'MECM.SDKProvider' THEN 'SMS Provider' WHEN 'MECM.ContentStorageDrive' THEN 'Content storage drive' ELSE t.Name END AS Role,
  v.DisplayName AS Object,
  CASE v.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Health,
  v.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v
JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0
  AND t.Name IN ('MECM.Hierarchy', 'MECM.PrimarySite', 'MECM.SiteServer', 'MECM.ManagementPoint', 'MECM.DistributionPoint', 'MECM.SoftwareUpdatePoint', 'MECM.ServiceConnectionPoint', 'MECM.SQLServer', 'MECM.SDKProvider', 'MECM.ContentStorageDrive')
  AND (NULLIF(v.Path, '') IS NULL OR LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ',')))
ORDER BY CASE v.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, 1, 2

panels.title: Site and roles

panels.description: Configuration Manager server components the management pack monitors for availability.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(' - ', v.DisplayName) > 0 THEN REPLACE(LEFT(v.DisplayName, CHARINDEX(' - ', v.DisplayName) - 1), 'ConfigMgr ', '') ELSE v.DisplayName END AS Component,
  CASE v.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Health,
  v.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v
JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'MECM.ServerComponent' AND NULLIF(v.Path, '') IS NOT NULL
  AND LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ','))
ORDER BY CASE v.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, 1, 2

panels.title: Server components

panels.description: Warning and Critical monitors on the Configuration Manager objects and the agent heartbeat of the selected servers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  CASE WHEN e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' THEN e.DisplayName ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(e.Path, CHARINDEX(';', e.Path + ';') - 1), ''), '(site)') END AS Host,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3) AND e.IsDeleted = 0
  AND s.MonitorName NOT IN ('System.Health.EntityState', 'System.Health.AvailabilityState', 'System.Health.ConfigurationState', 'System.Health.PerformanceState', 'System.Health.SecurityState')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1) OR s.MonitorName = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService.Heartbeat')
  AND ((e.FullName LIKE 'MECM.%' AND (LEFT(e.Path, CHARINDEX(';', e.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ',')) OR NULLIF(e.Path, '') IS NULL))
       OR (e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' AND e.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ','))))
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC

panels.title: Unhealthy monitors

panels.description: Open alerts in the selected time range. Alerts on the site or hierarchy belong to no single server, so they are listed whichever servers are selected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  a.Severity AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  CASE WHEN a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' THEN a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1), ''), '(site)') END AS Host,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, al.ResolutionState, al.Severity, al.TimeRaised, al.RepeatCount, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ((a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'MECM.%' AND (LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, ''), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, '') + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ',')) OR NULLIF(a.MonitoringObjectPath, '') IS NULL))
       OR (a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' AND a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${cmhost:csv}', ','))))
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC
